summaries.title: From GPT-4 to Gemini and Beyond: Assessing the Landscape of MLLMs on Generalizability, Trustworthiness and Causality through Four Modalities
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于综述与体系调研。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **From GPT-4 to Gemini and Beyond** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)）。核心论点主张：This paper strives to enhance understanding of the gap through the lens of a qualitative study on the generalizability, trustworthiness, and causal reasoning capabilities of...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：This paper strives to enhance understanding of the gap through the lens of a qualitative study on the generalizability, trustworthiness, and causal...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In total, we uncover 14 empirical findings that are useful to understand the capabilities and limitations of both proprietary and open-source MLLMs, towards more reliable downstream...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 37 赞），本工作系统梳理了 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)** 的技术谱系与开放难题，适合作为切入该赛道的全局路线图；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
